describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right profile against a plain off-white background, standing on four thick legs. Its overall body shape, dense long shaggy brown fur, short stub tail, and head shape are bear-like, with lighter tan fur on the muzzle and chest and darker brown on the lower legs. On its dorsal side are two large, smooth, glossy, dark reddish-brown hardened shell sections resembling beetle elytra, one covering the shoulder area and one covering the mid-back to hindquarters. A single large glossy dark brown to black curved horn projects from the forehead. The outer sides of the forelegs bear smaller overlapping glossy segmented plates of the same dark color, and a row of small circular holes is visible in the fur along the side below the rear shell. The feet are broad paws with light-colored claws.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature with the shaggy brown fur, head, legs, paws, claws and short tail of a brown bear, shown in side view walking to the right. A single long curved glossy dark beetle horn grows from its forehead, two large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shell plates sit on its back, one over the shoulders and one over the hindquarters, with a row of small round holes in the fur below the rear plate and glossy segmented beetle-like armor on the upper front legs.
